name: CanTrcv
description: Configuration of the CanTrcv (CAN Transceiver driver) module.

children.name: CanTrcvConfigSet
children.description: This container contains the configuration parameters and sub containers of the AUTOSAR WdgM module.

children.name: CanTrcvSPICommRetries
children.description: Indicates the maximum number of communication retries in case of a failed SPI communication (applies both to timed out communication and to errors/NACK in the response data).

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If configured value is '0', no retry is allowed (communication is expected to succeed at first try).

children.name: CanTrcvSPICommTimeout
children.description: Indicates the maximum time allowed to the CanTrcv for replying (either positively or negatively) to a SPI command.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Timeout is configured in milliseconds. Timeout value of '0' means that no specific timeout is to be used by CanTrcv and the communication is executed at the best of the SPI HW capacity.

children.name: CanTrcvChannel
children.description: Container gives CAN transceiver driver information about a single CAN

metadata.INTRODUCTION: transceiver (channel).

children.name: CanTrcvChannelId
children.description: Unique identifier of the CAN Transceiver Channel.

children.name: CanTrcvChannelUsed
children.description: Shall the related CAN transceiver channel be used?

children.name: CanTrcvControlsPowerSupply
children.description: Is ECU power supply controlled by this transceiver?

metadata.INTRODUCTION: TRUE = Controlled by transceiver. FALSE = Not controlled by transceiver.

children.name: CanTrcvHwPnSupport
children.description: Indicates whether the HW supports the selective wake-up function

metadata.INTRODUCTION: TRUE = Selective wakeup feature is supported by the transceiver FALSE = Selective wakeup functionality is not available in transceiver

children.name: CanTrcvInitState
children.description: State of CAN transceiver after call to CanTrcv_Init.

metadata.LITERALS: CANTRCV_OP_MODE_NORMAL AUTOSAR_ECUC CANTRCV_OP_MODE_SLEEP AUTOSAR_ECUC CANTRCV_OP_MODE_STANDBY AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: CanTrcvMaxBaudrate
children.description: Max baudrate for transceiver hardware type. Only used for validation purposes. Value shall be configured by configuration tool based on

metadata.INTRODUCTION: transceiver hardware type.

children.name: CanTrcvWakeupByBusUsed
children.description: Is wake up by bus supported? If CAN transceiver hardware does not support wake up by bus value is always FALSE. If CAN transceiver hardware supports wake up by bus value is TRUE or FALSE depending whether it is used or not.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: TRUE = Is used. FALSE = Is not used.

children.name: CanTrcvIcuChannelRef
children.description: Reference to the IcuChannel to enable/disable the interrupts

metadata.INTRODUCTION: for wakeups.

children.name: CanTrcvWakeupSourceRef
children.description: Reference to a wakeup source in the EcuM configuration.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: This reference is only needed if CanTrcvWakeupByBusUsed is true.

children.name: CanTrcvPorWakeupSourceRef
children.description: Symbolic name reference to specify the wakeup sources that should be used in the calls to EcuM_SetWakeupEvent as specified in [SWS_CanTrcv_00183] and [SWS_CanTrcv_00184].

metadata.INTRODUCTION: This reference is mandatory if the HW supports POR or SYSERR flags

children.name: CanTrcvSyserrWakeupSourceRef
children.description: Symbolic name reference to specify the wakeup sources that should be used in the calls to EcuM_SetWakeupEvent as specified in [SWS_CanTrcv_00183] and [SWS_CanTrcv_00184]

metadata.INTRODUCTION: This reference is mandatory if the HW supports POR or SYSERR flags

children.name: CanTrcvAccess
children.description: Container gives CanTrcv Driver information about access to a single CAN transceiver.

children.name: CanTrcvDioAccess
children.description: Container gives CAN transceiver driver information about accessing ports and port pins. In addition relation between CAN transceiver hardware pin names and Dio port access information is given.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If a CAN transceiver hardware has no Dio interface, there is no instance of this container.

children.name: CanTrcvDioChannelAccess
children.description: Container gives DIO channel access by single Can transceiver channel.

children.name: CanTrcvHardwareInterfaceName
children.description: CAN transceiver hardware interface name. It is typically the name of a pin. From a Dio point of view it is either a port, a single channel or a channel group. Depending on this fact either

metadata.INTRODUCTION: CANTRCV_DIO_PORT_SYMBOLIC_NAME or CANTRCV_DIO_CHANNEL_SYMBOLIC_NAME or CANTRCV_DIO_CHANNEL_GROUP_SYMBOLIC_NAME shall reference a Dio configuration. The CAN transceiver driver implementation description shall list up this name for the appropriate CAN transceiver hardware.

children.name: CanTrcvDioSymNameRef
children.description: Choice Reference to a DIO Port, DIO Channel or DIO Channel Group. This reference replaces the CANTRCV_DIO_PORT_SYM_NAME, CANTRCV_DIO_CHANNEL_SYM_NAME and CANTRCV_DIO_GROUP_SYM_NAME references in the Can Trcv SWS.

children.name: CanTrcvSpiAccess
children.description: Container gives CAN transceiver driver information about accessing Spi. If a CAN transceiver hardware has no Spi interface, there is no instance of this container.

children.name: CanTrcvSpiSequence
children.description: Container gives CAN transceiver driver information about one SPI sequence.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: One SPI sequence used by CAN transceiver driver is in exclusive use for it. No other driver is allowed to access this sequence. CAN transceiver driver may use one sequence to access n CAN transceiver hardwares chips of the same type or n sequences are used to access one single CAN transceiver hardware chip. If a CAN transceiver hardware has no SPI interface, there is no instance of this container.

children.name: CanTrcvSpiAccessSynchronous
children.description: This parameter is used to define whether the access to the Spi sequence is synchronous or asynchronous.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: SPI access is synchronous. false: SPI access is asynchronous.

children.name: CanTrcvSpiSequenceName
children.description: Reference to a Spi sequence configuration container.

children.name: CanTrcvDemEventParameterRefs
children.description: Container for the references to DemEventParameter elements which shall be invoked using the API Dem_ReportErrorStatus in case the corresponding error occurs. The EventId is taken from the referenced DemEventParameter's DemEventId value.

children.name: CANTRCV_E_BUS_ERROR
children.description: Reference to the DemEventParameter which shall be issued when bus error has occurred.

children.name: CanTrcvPartialNetwork
children.description: Container gives CAN transceiver driver information about the configuration of Partial Networking functionality.

children.name: CanTrcvBaudRate
children.description: Indicates the CAN Bus communication baud rate in kbps.

children.name: CanTrcvBusErrFlag
children.description: Indicates if the Bus Error (BUSERR) flag is managed by the BSW. This flag is set if a bus failure is detected by the transceiver.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: TRUE = Supported by transceiver and managed by BSW. FALSE = Not managed by BSW.

children.name: CanTrcvPnCanIdIsExtended
children.description: Indicates whether extended or standard ID is used.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: TRUE = Extended Can identifier is used. FALSE = Standard Can identifier is used

children.name: CanTrcvPnEnabled
children.description: Indicates whether the selective wake-up function is enabled or disabled in HW.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: TRUE = Selective wakeup feature is enabled in the transceiver hardware FALSE = Selective wakeup feature is disabled in the transceiver hardware

children.name: CanTrcvPnFrameCanId
children.description: CAN ID of the Wake-up Frame (WUF).

children.name: CanTrcvPnFrameCanIdMask
children.description: ID Mask for the selective activation of the transceiver. It is used to enableFrame Wake-up (WUF) on a group of IDs.

children.name: CanTrcvPnFrameDlc
children.description: Data Length of the Wake-up Frame (WUF).

children.name: CanTrcvPowerOnFlag
children.description: Description: Indicates if the Power On Reset (POR) flag is available and is managed by the transceiver.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: TRUE = Supported by Hardware. FALSE = Not supported by Hardware

children.name: CanTrcvPnFrameDataMaskSpec
children.description: Defines data payload mask to be used on the received payload in order to determine if the transceiver must be woken up by the received Wake-up Frame (WUF).

children.name: CanTrcvPnFrameDataMask
children.description: Defines the n byte (Byte0 = LSB) of the data payload mask to be used on the received payload in order to determine if the transceiver must be woken up by the received Wake-up Frame (WUF).

children.name: CanTrcvPnFrameDataMaskIndex
children.description: holds the position n in frame of the mask-part

children.name: CanTrcvGeneral
children.description: Container gives CAN transceiver driver basic information.

children.name: CanTrcvDevErrorDetect
children.description: Switches the Default Error Tracer (Det) detection and notification ON or OFF.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: * true: enabled (ON). * false: disabled (OFF). If enabled, #define CANTRCV_DEV _ERROR_DETECT ON shall be generated. If disabled, #define CANTRCV_DEV_ERROR _DETECT OFF shall be generated. Define shall be part of file CanTrcv_Cfg.h.

children.name: CanTrcvGetVersionInfo
children.description: Switches version information API on and off. If switched off, function need not be present in compiled code.

children.name: CanTrcvIndex
children.description: Specifies the InstanceId of this module instance. If only one instance is present it shall have the Id 0.

children.name: CanTrcvMainFunctionDiagnosticsPeriod
children.description: This parameter describes the period for cyclic call to CanTrcv_MainFunctionDiagnostics. Unit is seconds.

children.name: CanTrcvMainFunctionPeriod
children.description: This parameter describes the period for cyclic call to CanTrcv_MainFunction. Unit is seconds.

children.name: CanTrcvTimerType
children.description: Type of the Time Service Predefined Timer.

children.name: CanTrcvWaitTime
children.description: Wait time for transceiver state changes in seconds.

children.name: CanTrcvWakeUpSupport
children.description: Informs whether wake up is supported by polling or not supported. In case no

metadata.INTRODUCTION: wake up is supported by the hardware, setting has to be NOT_SUPPORTED. Only in the case of wake up supported by polling, function CanTrcv_MainFunction has to be present and to be invoked by the scheduler.
